pages.text: This page documents every $(#8a5a2b)/wandscape$() command. Player-facing commands are grouped by domain; developer/debug commands live under $(#8a5a2b)/wandscape test$() (op-2 only).$(br2)$(italic)$(#6b5a45)Permissions: - $(bold)No permission$()$(italic)$(#6b5a45): read-only queries and rescue commands — any player. - $(bold)op-2 (admin)$()$(italic)$(#6b5a45): commands that mutate a colony's assets/values. - $(bold)test (developer)$()$(italic)$(#6b5a45): low-impact or obscure tuning/testing commands — op-2, invisible to normal players in autocomplete.$()

$(li)$(#8a5a2b)/wandscape colony status$() — level/exp/three-values/tourists/mages/elements/works-under-construction (no op)$(li)$(#8a5a2b)/wandscape colony list$() — list all registered colonies (no op)$(li)$(#8a5a2b)/wandscape colony create <name>$() — create a colony ahead and spawn starter mages (op-2)$(li)$(#8a5a2b)/wandscape colony destroy$() — destroy the executor's colony (op-2)$(li)$(#8a5a2b)/wandscape colony level <n>$() — set colony level directly (op-2, resets exp)$(li)$(#8a5a2b)/wandscape colony exp <n>$() — grant experience (op-2, may trigger level-up)$(li)$(#8a5a2b)/wandscape colony name <name>$() — rename the colony (op-2)
pages.title: Colony

pages.text: $(li)$(#8a5a2b)/wandscape element view$() — view the 7 element balances (no op)$(li)$(#8a5a2b)/wandscape element add <type> <amount>$() — add elements (op-2; earth/wood/water/fire/metal/wind/dark)$(li)$(#8a5a2b)/wandscape element remove <type> <amount>$() — remove elements (op-2)$(li)$(#8a5a2b)/wandscape element clear$() — clear all elements (op-2)
pages.title: Element

pages.text: $(li)$(#8a5a2b)/wandscape warehouse view$() — item count/usage/capacity (no op)$(li)$(#8a5a2b)/wandscape warehouse add <itemId> <amount>$() — add items (op-2)$(li)$(#8a5a2b)/wandscape warehouse remove <itemId> <amount>$() — remove items (op-2)$(li)$(#8a5a2b)/wandscape warehouse clear$() — clear all items (op-2)
pages.title: Warehouse (items only)

pages.text: $(li)$(#8a5a2b)/wandscape building list [category]$() — list colony buildings (no op; category optional)$(li)$(#8a5a2b)/wandscape building cancel <buildingId>$() — cancel an under-construction building and refund materials (op-2; short id prefix ok)$(li)$(#8a5a2b)/wandscape building demolish <buildingId>$() — demolish a building (op-2)
pages.title: Building

pages.text: $(li)$(#8a5a2b)/wandscape road status$() — network edges/build status/total length (no op)$(li)$(#8a5a2b)/wandscape road cancel <edgeId>$() — withdraw an under-construction road edge and refund materials (op-2)
pages.title: Road

pages.text: $(li)$(#8a5a2b)/wandscape npc list [idle]$() — mage roster (level/idle/task/HP/mana/spells; no op)$(li)Recruiting a mage → $(#8a5a2b)/wandscape tavern recruit$() (op-2); training/level-up happens in the Mage Hut UI.
pages.title: NPC

pages.text: $(li)$(#8a5a2b)/wandscape tourist list$() — tourist roster (state/level/three-need bars; no op)$(li)$(#8a5a2b)/wandscape tourist clear$() — clear all tourists in the colony (no op, triggers normal departure; use when stuck/overcrowded)
pages.title: Tourist

pages.text: $(li)$(#8a5a2b)/wandscape tavern list$() — pending mage resumes (no op)$(li)$(#8a5a2b)/wandscape tavern recruit$() — recruit one mage (op-2; first free, then 10000 of every element)
pages.title: Tavern

pages.text: $(li)$(#8a5a2b)/wandscape guard status$() — guard zones/nearest threat/active guard tasks (no op)
pages.title: Guard

pages.text: $(li)$(#8a5a2b)/wandscape recover status$() — task pool/building queue state (no op)$(li)$(#8a5a2b)/wandscape recover clear$() — clear tasks, building queues, reset mages (no op; $(bold)last resort before lock-up$() — interrupts all running tasks)
pages.title: Recovery

pages.text: $(li)$(#8a5a2b)/wandscape guide [page]$() — open the guidebook (no op; defaults to this page, or open any page like $(#8a5a2b)warehouse$())
pages.title: Guide
